name: Daily Delicious Beauty Protein Mix Raspberry
headline: Daily Delicious Beauty Protein Mix Raspberry
howToUse: Take 25 g of powder (2 heaped scoops) a day, dissolved in 250 ml of low-fat (1.5%) milk.

manufacturing.expiration: 18 months from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Vitamin A, vitamin C, vitamin E, niacin, folate (folic acid), biotin, pantothenic acid, magnesium (magnesium citrate), selenium (L-selenomethionine), copper, branched-chain amino acids (L-isoleucine, L-leucine, L-valine), PABA (para-aminobenzoic acid), excipients.
